list_child.name: listLeases
list_child.desc: Retrieves the full roster of lease agreements currently on file for this management company. Use it when you need to see every lease at once rather than looking up a single record.

get_child.name: getLease
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single lease agreement using its unique identifier. This is the appropriate call when you already know which lease you want and just need its current details.

list_parent.name: listLandlords
list_parent.desc: Retrieves every landlord account registered with this property management company. Useful for browsing ownership records before drilling into a specific landlord's leases.

get_parent.name: getLandlord
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single landlord account by its identifier. Use this to pull up ownership and contact details for one landlord specifically.

delete_child.name: deleteLease
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a lease agreement from the system, which cannot be undone once submitted. Only use this for records that should no longer exist in any report or filing.

set_enum.name: setLeaseStage
set_enum.desc: Updates a lease agreement's stage to draft, active, or terminated, reflecting where it currently stands. This should be called any time the lease's standing changes so downstream reports stay accurate.

set_bool.name: flagRenewalPending
set_bool.desc: Marks a lease agreement as being up for renewal in the near future. This helps the renewals team prioritize which agreements need outreach first.

set_ref.name: reassignLandlord
set_ref.desc: Transfers a lease agreement to a different landlord's portfolio within the system. Use this when ownership of the underlying property changes hands.

send.name: emailLandlord
send.desc: Sends an email notification to a landlord regarding one of their properties. This is the standard channel for routine updates that do not require a phone call.
